CNGJS_options_menu_desc: These changes will not apply until you restart your game or exit out a heist.
CNGJS_options_menu_active_job_amount_des:
Choose how many jobs do you want spawned in on Crime.Net.
Default is 10.
CNGJS_options_menu_active_job_timer_desc:
Choose how long should jobs stay on Crime.Net before they go away.
Default is 25.
CNGJS_options_menu_normalize_new_job_tim:
If checked, new active jobs will appear more constant by setting the time to 1.5 seconds.
By default, this is turned off.
